prediction.headline: NIFTY is more likely to fall than rise today

why: NIFTY is at 25,838, up 19 points (+0.07%) from yesterday's close of 25,819.
This morning it opened 54 points higher than yesterday's close and has fallen 35 points since.

India VIX, the market's 'fear gauge', is 17.2 (down 3% since yesterday: traders expect smaller moves than before). That points to a normal, lively market: NIFTY could move about 280 points up or down over the whole day.
Big news for the whole market today: Stock Crash: Norwegian budget carrier plunges 86% after warning finances are 'critical'.
Also: our forecast team's view is positive.
The desk follows the move since this morning's open, which is falling, so it expects more of the same today. Some of the news points the other way.
plan: At 10:00 the desk buys two contracts on NIFTY for this week: a call, which makes money if NIFTY rises, and a put, which makes money if it falls. A big enough move either way pays more than the two cost together. It tilts the pair toward a fall, so a fall pays more than a rise. It takes profit at +50%, cuts the loss at -35%, and closes everything by 15:15. All trades are on paper.
